Name: Update Tracker
Author: wh0pp
Description:
[size=6][b]Update Tracker[/b][/size]

[b]No mod manager? No problem.[/b]

If your Mods folder is a hand-curated pile of unzipped downloads, SMAPI's update alerts scroll past in the console and are easy to miss. Update Tracker puts them where you can't: a small button on the title screen. See what needs updating [i]before[/i] you load a save, open the exact Nexus page for each mod, and ignore the ones you're deliberately not updating.

No mod manager, no account linking, no API keys, no extra downloads 🚀 🚀 🚀 It reuses the update check SMAPI already runs - and on Android, where that check is compiled out, it asks SMAPI's web API once per session.

[line]

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]A small button in the bottom-left of the title screen.[/*]
[*]Shows a skull when updates are available and the happy pink cat when everything is up to date.[/*]
[*]A notification badge counts how many updates are waiting.[/*]
[*]Click the button for a centered list of your installed mods that have a Nexus page.[/*]
[*]Mods with updates are listed first, with [i]installed -> latest[/i] versions.[/*]
[*]Every row has an [b]Open[/b] button that takes you straight to that mod's Nexus page.[/*]
[*]Click the bell to ignore a mod. Ignored mods get a red X over the bell, stop counting toward the badge, and are remembered across sessions.[/*]
[*]The list opens as a full title-screen menu: the background dims and the title buttons step out of the way.[/*]
[*]Scroll long lists with the mouse wheel, by dragging on a touchscreen, or with the arrows beside the list. Esc, the close button, or the back button closes it.[/*]
[*]The title screen button grows and plays the game's button sounds when hovered and clicked, like the title screen's own buttons.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Why use it if you install mods by hand?[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]You don't have to watch the SMAPI console for update alerts that disappear as the game loads.[/*]
[*]You get a clear to-do list before you start playing, instead of discovering an outdated mod mid-save.[/*]
[*]Clicking [b]Open[/b] saves you searching Nexus for the mod you just saw on the title screen.[/*]
[*]Ignoring a mod is persistent, so optional or intentionally pinned mods stop nagging you.[/*]
[*]Works with large hand-managed Mods folders, including mods SMAPI skips because of missing dependencies.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15[/b] or later[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] [b]4.0.0[/b] or later[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI (if you haven't already).[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
No mod manager needed. The zip contains a single [b]UpdateTracker[/b] folder; drop it in [b]Mods[/b] and you're done. Nothing else to configure.

[size=5][b]Usage[/b][/size]
Once the title screen has finished loading, the button appears in the bottom-left corner. Click it to open the list.

[list]
[*][b]Open[/b] opens that mod's Nexus Mods page in your browser.[/*]
[*][b]Bell[/b] ignores or un-ignores a mod. Ignored mods still appear in the list, but no longer count toward the badge.[/*]
[*][b]Arrows[/b] beside the list page up and down; on a touchscreen you can also drag the list itself.[/*]
[*][b]Esc[/b], the close button, or the back button closes the list.[/*]
[/list]
Ignored mods are saved in [b]config.json[/b] in the mod folder, so your choices survive restarts.

[line]

[size=5][b]How it works / limitations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The mod reads SMAPI's existing update-check results. It never contacts Nexus, and needs no API key, no account, and no login.[/*]
[*]On PC it makes no network requests of its own at all - SMAPI does the checking, and Update Tracker only reads the results.[/*]
[*]If SMAPI's own check isn't available (the Android port compiles it out, or [b]CheckForUpdates[/b] is disabled), the mod asks SMAPI's public web API the same question instead. That's [b]at most one request per game session[/b], and it contains only each installed mod's unique ID, installed version, and update keys - no save data, no account details, nothing that identifies you.[/*]
[*]You can turn that fallback off completely with [b]EnableWebFallback: false[/b] in the mod's config.json. Update data will then be missing on those platforms, but the mod is guaranteed not to connect to anything.[/*]
[*]Only mods with a Nexus update key in their manifest are listed. Mods whose updates come from other sites are intentionally left out.[/*]
[*]If neither SMAPI's own check nor the fallback is available, no update badges will appear.[/*]
[*]SMAPI also checks mods that it skips during loading (such as mods with missing dependencies); those are recovered from SMAPI's console update alerts. Skipped mods that are already up to date cannot be listed.[/*]
[*]No Harmony patches. The button uses its own artwork (theme packs can replace [b]assets/config-button.png[/b]); the ignore bells use the game's chat emoji texture.[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional and only affects where the button sits (next to its gear). It is not required.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Pathoschild for [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], which provides the update data.[/*]
[*]Google Gemini for this page's obvious AI artwork/banner image and documentation. [/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Changelog[/b][/size]
[b]1.2.0[/b]
[list]
[*]The mod list now scrolls on Android: drag anywhere on a row, or use the arrows beside the list.[/*]
[*]Starting a drag on an Open or bell button now scrolls the list instead of activating that button.[/*]
[*]Larger panel with taller rows, and an Open button whose label no longer overlaps its border.[/*]
[*]Bigger ignore bells and scroll arrows, plus no hover tooltips on touch screens.[/*]
[*]Long mod names and versions are trimmed with an ellipsis instead of crowding each other off the row.[/*]
[*]The scroll arrows sit outside the panel and the row counter moved into the heading, leaving the full height for mods.[/*]
[*]The list opens as a proper title-screen menu: the background dims, the title buttons step aside, and the game's own close/back button closes it. Clicking outside no longer closes the list.[/*]
[*]The title screen button grows slightly on hover and plays the game's button sounds, matching the title screen's other buttons.[/*]
[/list]
[b]1.1.0[/b]
[list]
[*]Android support: update checks via SMAPI's web API, and browser links opened with Android's Intent API.[/*]
[*]The web API fallback is a single request per game session, cached for the rest of the run, and only contains mod IDs, versions, and update keys. Set the new [b]EnableWebFallback[/b] config option to false to disable it entirely.[/*]
[*]Reorganized the source into src/UpdateTracker with separate models, services, and UI files.[/*]
[*]Added an optional ADB deploy target for Android.[/*]
[/list]
[b]1.0.0[/b]
[list]
[*]Initial release.[/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Main file for Update Tracker 1.2.0 (PC and Android). Unzip into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder - no mod manager needed. Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ and SMAPI 4.0.0+. Android players can now scroll the list by dragging.
